subject: Re: DevCon Global — demo exchange & hero banner / sponsorship terms
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@devcon.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: DevCon Global sponsorship opportunity — speaking vs. demo exchange

Hi Irene,

Appreciated the intro from Carlos — great to hear Redwood is evaluating event partnerships for the fall. DevCon Global (Oct 12-14, San Jose) is finalizing its sponsorship roster and we have a flexible option that could be a good fit: swap a prime speaking slot for hands-on exec demos on the expo floor.

High-level:
- Sponsor level: "Summit Engineering" ($75k list) includes 30-min breakout, logo on hero site and app, small expo kiosk, and 2 exhibitor badges.
- Alternative: upgrade to a keynote or move to a 60-min theater session for an additional fee.
- Demo exchange proposal: if Redwood commits to running 3 scheduled demos per day and supplies an expert host, we can bump you to hero banner placement, a premium demo location adjacent to the theater, and expanded expo visibility (listed as "demo partner").

I've attached the current sponsor package (DevCon_Sponsor_Pkg_v4.pdf) and the logo specs. Could you confirm whether a demo-exchange (3/day) is something your events team could support? If so, we can draft a tailored quote and lock a tentative speaking slot.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Partnerships Lead — DevCon Global
Attachment: DevCon_Sponsor_Pkg_v4.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: logo_specs_300dpi.png (PNG)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@devcon.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DevCon Global sponsorship opportunity — speaking vs. demo exchange

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and the package. We're interested in the demo-exchange path but I have a few clarifying questions before we commit:

1) Demo logistics: what is the footprint and power/AV available at the "premium demo location"? Is there a dedicated table + monitor or a 6x6 booth?
2) Attendance expectations for scheduled demos vs open demos (est. attendees per demo?)
3) Speaking slot: can the 30-min breakout be extended to 45 minutes with a 10-min demo window at the end?
4) Logo placement: what exactly do you mean by "hero banner" — site banner only or on-site stage banner as well?
5) Passes: can we get 4 exhibitor badges for the demo staff rather than the two listed in the base package?
6) Exclusivity: any vertical/category exclusivity for our segment (inference/serving runtimes)?

Looping in Marissa (events ops) and Connor (field marketing) to confirm operational feasibility. We could probably staff 3 demos/day during peak hours with a product engineer and AM, but need to confirm booth footprint and schedule.

If you can share a proposed schedule template and any technical requirements, we'll review quickly.

Thanks,
Irene
Director, Field Marketing — Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@devcon.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ramirez <c.ramirez@scaleup.co>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DevCon Global sponsorship opportunity — speaking vs. demo exchange

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick questions — answers below inline:

1) Footprint: premium demo location is a 10x10 kiosk with dedicated 110V power and AV feed. Includes one 42" monitor, a lockable cabinet, and a tall demo counter. If you need additional racks or GPUs we can arrange on-site rental for a fee.
2) Attendance: scheduled demos (promoted on the agenda and app) typically draw 25-40 attendees; open demos vary but high-visibility kiosks see steady traffic during breaks.
3) Speaking slot: we can do a 45-min breakout + 10-min demo window if we move you to "Premier Breakout" — that will require a small additional promo fee, but we can offset part of it via upgraded placement if you commit to the demo cadence.
4) Hero banner: includes homepage hero rotation for the week, app hero placement, and a stage-facing vinyl banner (6' x 2') outside the breakout theater.
5) Passes: standard package includes 2 exhibitor badges; we can expand to 4 for an incremental fee, or include 4 with a $7k upsell.
6) Exclusivity: we offer category exclusivity only at the Summit level (keynote sponsor). We can guarantee no competing demo partners in the immediate demo cluster, but we can't promise site-wide exclusivity at the package level.

Pricing: base = $75k; Premier Breakout + hero banner + premium demo location + 4 exhibitor badges = $92k list. If Redwood commits to the 3 demos/day schedule (we'd list you as "Official Demo Partner" in the app & agenda) we can offer a $12k promotional credit (bringing net to $80k) and guarantee the premium kiosk location.

Attaching the sponsor package v4 again and the logo spec. If you can share a draft of the demos schedule (times + staff) we can mark the provisional speaking slot on our side.

Best,
Samantha
Attachment: DevCon_Sponsor_Pkg_v4.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: logo_specs_300dpi.png (PNG)

Subject: Internal — DevCon summary & negotiation plan (please read)

Team — quick summary from Samantha: premium demo location (10x10 kiosk), hero banner + stage-facing vinyl, 45+10 slot available with upsell, 4 exhibitor badges add $7k or included as package for higher tier; net with the demo commitment ~$80k.

Negotiation goals (we should push on all of these):
- Upgrade included exhibitor badges to 4 at no extra cost (we should ask for 6 if possible; 4 is minimum)
- Hero banner + theater vinyl must be explicitly guaranteed in writing (homepage rotation + stage vinyl)
- Move to Premier Breakout with 45+10 but request a 5-10 minute moderated panel instead of a hard demo if stage AV is limited
- Request closer demo kiosk placement (adjacent to main traffic flow / at theater entrance) and priority scheduling for peak times (11:30–1:30 and 3:00–4:30)
- Insist on a mutual NDA/statement that we won't be listed adjacent to direct competitors in promotional copy near our hero banner (reasonable control of surrounding logos)

Tactics: propose $55k as our initial counter and highlight the pilot nature (trade credit + speaking exposure in exchange for running the demos). If they push back, escalate to $65k + 4 badges + guaranteed hero placement + priority demo schedule.

Marissa: can you draft a short counter we can send externally? Connor: confirm staffing availability for 3 demos/day and identify 2 engineers who can travel. Karthik: check budget/funding (events line) and whether we can offer travel reimbursement vs. lump sum.

Thanks,
Irene
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Redwood counter — DevCon demo-exchange / sponsorship terms

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and attachments. We ran this by ops and field; Redwood is very interested in being the Official Demo Partner, but we need a few items firmed up. Our counter is below:

Counter (Redwood):
- Fee: $55,000 net (we're proposing a promotional pilot rate to evaluate ROI)
- Speaking: Premier Breakout 45-min + 10-min demo window (we'll produce a 30-min presentation + 15-min moderated Q&A + 10-min demo)
- Demo commitment: 3 scheduled demos/day for 3 days (9 total). Redwood will supply product engineer + field AM.
- Expo: guaranteed premium kiosk (10x10) adjacent to theater entrance; priority demo scheduling during lunch and late-afternoon windows.
- Promotion: hero banner on site + app, stage-facing vinyl as described; Redwood logo on printed program near theater.
- Badges: 4 exhibitor badges included (no incremental fee).
- Exclusivity: no competing demo partners within immediate demo cluster; no site-wide exclusivity required.

We can sign immediately if DevCon can accept the $55k pilot rate and provide a draft that includes the logo placement commitments and kiosk placement map. We are okay to include a short pilot clause: one-time promotional rate for 2026 with performance review post-event.

Attached: Redwood_DevCon_Pkg_Redlines.pdf (redlines to your standard package)

If you accept, please send a DocuSign and we will route through procurement. Alternatively, we can escalate verbally to close.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Events — Redwood Inference
